title: Rows and columns
prompt: This program counts things in the `learners` and `courses` tables above. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
hints: There are three `print` calls, so there are three lines.
`count()` counts rows. The column names on top of a table aren't a row.
`columns` is the list of column names, so `len` of it is the number of columns, not rows.
